name: B10-0343/2025 (PfE) – Urgent need to protect religious minorities in Syria following the recent terrorist attack on Mar Elias Church in Damascus
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the urgent need to protect religious minorities in Syria following the recent terrorist attack on Mar Elias Church in Damascus
part_text:
The European Parliament condemns the June 2025 terrorist attack on the Mar Elias church in Damascus, where a gunman killed at least 25 worshippers. It asks Syria's transitional government to investigate the attack fully, protect religious minorities and their places of worship, and keep radical Islamist ideology out of its government and laws. It also asks the European Union to raise the protection of religious communities in its talks with Syria's authorities. The text is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- The Parliament calls for an independent investigation and for those behind the attack to be held accountable.
- It asks Syria's transitional government to protect religious communities and drop restrictive dress codes for women.
- The European Union should raise religious freedom in talks with Syria; EU aid conditions could be reversed if commitments fail.
